paper_title: 高速公路应急车道紧急启用模型

argumentation_roles.lesson: Show the exact FPS/window/track-to-flow-density-speed contract next to representative frames; the visualization should make physical units and aggregation interval auditable.
Use chronological/cross-video holdout, full event-level alarm metrics and metric-algebra-consistent tables. Architecture diagrams do not substitute for a runnable sequence graph.
Show likelihood/capacity fit → threshold derivation → gray zone/hysteresis → confusion or operating-characteristic evidence. Do not jump from a fitted distribution to an unexplained threshold.
Before/after dashboards should distinguish observed interventions from transferred/model-based counterfactuals and replay every percentage from the underlying values.

Plot candidate geometry/coverage, feasible decision variables, Pareto or scalarized tradeoff, and mediated effect on control quality; traffic metrics alone do not prove a placement caused improvement.
